title: Organized the US developer portal hackathon
summary: With the Software Excellence team, I organized a two-day hackathon in Cambridge where teams, some travelling from other US sites, built on the internal developer portal.
what_would_have_happened: The portal would be adopted slowly, one team at a time.
the_call: Get teams building on the portal together in a hackathon judged by senior leaders.
what_i_did: Organized the two-day event with the Software Excellence team and announced the winners and the teams' work to the community.
what_changed: The results post was seen by 1,569 people, and registration opened for the next editions in Brazil and India.
